correctness.rationale: The known continuous null gives iid uniforms and exchangeable Dirichlet(1,…,1) spacings. Every cyclic j-spacing sum is Beta(j,N−j), so averaging over origins preserves the mean. Differentiation of the beta integral gives the two harmonic-number log moments. Pairing j and N−j with the fixed weights gives the harmonic contribution (N−1)(N+2)/N and the claimed log sum. With F_N=N(m_N−1), subtraction and integration by parts give ΔF_N=2N(N+1)∫₀¹ t(1−t)/(N+t)³ dt>0. For N>1, the logarithmic derivative of N(N+1)/(N+t)³ is bounded above by 1/N−2/(N+1)<0. Hence ΔF_N decreases strictly, and G_N=NΔF_N−F_N decreases strictly because its increment equals (N+1)(ΔF_{N+1}−ΔF_N). Independently enclosed F20<0<F21 and G55<0<G54 settle both global classifications since the sign of G_N gives the sign of m_{N+1}−m_N. The integral gives ΔF_N=1/(3N)+O(N⁻²) uniformly and thus the stated asymptotic. Each summand is a nonnegative Bernoulli relative-entropy score after multiplying by −2, positive with positive probability, so division by m_N is well defined and cannot change within-n ordering.
residual_risks: Enclosures certify the required finite signs, not monotonicity by finite extrapolation; the strict integral inequalities give the infinite-range conclusions. Neither fitted null parameters, dependence, discrete nulls, nor other circular pooling rules are covered.

value.rationale: For an existing goodness-of-fit score whose asymptotic reference mean is one, the exact mean gives a benchmark across sample sizes and an exact deterministic standardization. The small peak overshoot is not the value by itself: the discrepancy is much larger below one at small n (for n=1, m_2=2−2 log 2), and the proof locates the only sign reversal and the only turning point over the whole integer range. Neither classification follows from asymptotic unit mean.
residual_risks: Mean centering alone does not supply critical values, tail probabilities, better test size, or better power. Within a fixed sample size it leaves rejection ordering unchanged.
